evidence-grounded.why: I checked each line's evidence. Line 1 PASS names wrong builds it tried, "only documents the flag or doesn't wire it in" and one that "uppercases only the name (`Hello, ADA!`)", and says the HELLO, ADA! example catches them. Line 2 PASS names a build that "makes shouting the default or always uppercases" and says running `node bin/greet.js Ada` catches it. Line 3 FAIL gives the concrete reason the line only shows after merge: pages.yml publishes docs/ "only on push to main". It also names a wrong build that leaves docs/index.md unchanged. The cited facts match the repository. bin/greet.js does drop `--` arguments through `find((a) => !a.startsWith('--'))`. test/greet.test.js has a `cli` test expecting `Hello, Ada!\n`. pages.yml triggers on push to main with path docs. docs/index.md has no --shout. Nothing cited is invented.

That names both the file and the trigger. The wrong_build section says the same thing, and the output also suggests a line that can be checked at PR time (docs/index.md documents --shout).
